title: The Fish Guyz
description:
S06 E08 — Snackle Time
George and Lain stock up on much-needed supplies at Marathon Tackle; Capt. Bob Beighley guides the Guyz to an action-packed day catching bull sharks and cobia in the Gulf of Mexico; chef Cat shares her recipe for fish tacos.

title: Spear Life
description:
S04 E09 — Wallhanger Hogfish With the Martini Boys
Jon, Gary and Coby head back to one of their favorite places to dive, Myrtle Beach, South Carolina; by the end of the trip, three people break personal records; one person finally gets their wall-hanger hogfish they've been after for years.

title: Julie Higgs Spearfishing
description:
S01 E04 — Spearfishing Madagascar
Julie, Luis, Juan, and Kirstie travel to Madagascar to spearfish new species with the goal of spearfishing the infamous Dog.

title: Uncharted Waters With Peter Miller
description:
S07 E02 — Giant Tuna Fishing in Cape Cod Bay
Peter targets the largest bluefin tuna of his life off Cape Cod, Mass.; trying to best 800 pounds, he's using live bluefish and butterfish chunks for bait; he witnesses a feeding frenzy of giant tuna and thresher shark with Captain Damon Sacco.

title: Livin' the Dream With Captain Jimmy Nelson
description:
S09 E12 — Epic Costa Rica Inshore Fishing Pt 1
Livin' the Dream follows Captain Jimmy Nelson and his wife Luiza as they travel and fish in exotic locales.

title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
description:
S25 E12 — The Industry Standard: Marathon, Florida Keys
George Poveromo combines reef fishing and freediving for stone crab and lobster off Marathon in the Florida Keys.

title: Saltwater Underground With Nick Honachefsky
description:
Marathon Reef Madness
Nick hops on board with Capt. Jimmy Gagliardini bailing reef fish of snapper, mahi, grouper, macks and more along the Marathon patch reefs.
